utility.notes: SCE's own 'Incorporated Cities and Counties Served by SCE' fact sheet (updated 3/17/2025) explicitly lists 'Glendora' by name among the cities in its service area.

value.name: Southern California Edison (SCE)
value.notes: Clean Power Alliance's own homepage states it serves '38 communities across Los Angeles and Ventura counties' and names each one individually via its site's community directory; Glendora is not among the named communities. No other Los Angeles/Ventura County CCA serving Glendora was found, so Southern California Edison (SCE) is recorded as both the distribution and generation utility.

county.notes: Glendora is a well-documented Los Angeles County city; also listed under Los Angeles County in SCE's own service-area fact sheet.

permit_authority.value: City of Glendora Building and Safety Division
permit_authority.notes: Directly re-verified via browser this session (an earlier HTTP 403 to automated fetch was intermittent, not a persistent block). ecode360.com (host of the city's municipal code) presents a Cloudflare bot-challenge screen and was not bypassed.

permit_url.notes: Directly re-verified via browser this session. The Solar Photovoltaic section states SolarAPP+ streamlined permitting is 'Coming Soon' (not yet live), so no instant-issuance timeline is recorded; only a LA County Fire Dept solar/ESS notification PDF is linked, and that PDF triggers a file-download dialog rather than a viewable page (dead-end).

interconnection_url.notes: SCE's own Net Energy Metering (NEM) program page — a utility-wide fact already established for other SCE-territory records this session.

value.name: SGIP - Residential Solar and Storage Equity
value.administrator: Southern California Edison (SCE), under the CPUC's Self-Generation Incentive Program
value.description: Storage incentive of $1,100/kWh paired with a solar incentive of $3,100/kW, funded via a $280 million CPUC-authorized budget that opened for reservations June 2, 2025. Administered by SCE across its entire distribution territory, which includes Glendora/Los Angeles County.
value.eligibility: PG&E or SCE residential customers (general market tier)

battery_programs.notes: Same statewide CPUC-administered SGIP program already confirmed for other SCE-territory records this session, reused as a utility-level fact.

required_documents.notes: cityofglendora.gov returned HTTP 403 to automated fetch on every attempt this session, blocking access to the city's solar submittal requirements.

value: Schedule inspections through the Civic Access portal (My Work tab); requests must be submitted by 4:00pm the business day prior to the requested inspection
For legacy permits issued before July 2025, call the eTrakit Inspection Request Line at (626) 657-7273 instead
Verify the scheduled inspection time via the Civic Access dashboard after 8:00am on the day of inspection; inspection hours are Monday-Friday 9:00am-3:30pm
inspection_steps.notes: This is the City's general Building Division inspection-scheduling process (the same page covers all building permit types, including solar); the City does not publish a separate, solar-specific inspection sequence.

timeline_days.notes: Search-engine synthesis suggested a 3-day expedited timeline consistent with the city's expedited-permitting ordinance, but the underlying page could not be directly fetched this session (HTTP 403), so no figure is recorded per the rule against using search snippets as evidence.
